# CANDIDATE: VWAP_PULLBACK_TO_RIBBON_SUPPORT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price pulls back to VWAP while the EMA ribbon is bullish aligned after an opening range break, offering a long entry with confluence of mean-reversion and trend. This setup captures intraday momentum continuation after initial range expansion, exploiting the tendency of strong trends to respect VWAP as dynamic support during pullbacks.

## Mechanism

Entry: After the opening range (first 30 min) high is broken on close, wait for a bar where close is within 0.1% of VWAP (ABS(close-VWAP)/VWAP < 0.001), close > 8 EMA, and 21 EMA > 55 EMA; enter long at the close of that bar. Exit: chart-stop at the low of the entry bar, TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail using chandelier exit (3*ATR(22) below high). Regime filters: VIX < 18, time 09:45-11:30, market making higher highs and higher lows (HH/HL structure).
